card.name: Words just before vial or container
card.fires_on: Small linking or counting words (of, each, one, in, a small) right before a container noun such as vial, ampoule or vessel, mostly in preparation instructions.

modes.label: Quantity before vial
modes.description: A count or determiner like each, one or 2 directly before vial.
modes.example: The contents of<< each>> vial are sterile and non-py

modes.label: Partway through reconstituted
modes.description: The ending of reconstituted just before vial.
modes.example: Withdraw the contents from one reconstit<<uted>> vial and add to one 2

modes.label: Supplied in container form
modes.description: Linking word before a packaging noun like ampoules or vessel.
modes.example: The amyl nitrite is supplied<< in>> the form of inhalant ampoules

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward container nouns like container, bottle and cylinder, and away from box words.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a vial or similar container is named.
